title: Throughput canary for autoscale setpoints (steady plateau + microburst mix)
creator: Sasha Mironov
description: Objective: Build a repeatable canary that validates autoscaling setpoints and dedicated pool behavior under a mixed workload: long steady-state throughput with interleaved short micro-bursts. Primary metrics: tokens/sec (aggregate & per-instance), p95 latency, tail error rate, and KV-cache warmup impact.
acceptance_criteria: Automated harness can run a 4h steady plateau at configurable tokens/sec with configurable micro-burst schedule
Dashboard showing tokens/sec and p95 per-model and per-instance for each run
Regression detector alerts when p95 increases by >15% vs baseline or tokens/sec drops by >10% for 3 consecutive windows
Harness integrated into nightly CI and produces reproducible artifacts (raw traces, aggregated metrics, and summary)
Playbook with mitigation steps for common failures (batching misalignment, cache cold starts, kernel selection regressions)
steps_to_run: 1) Deploy dedicated test pool (test-dedicated-3) with 4x A100 equiv; pin runtime-1.20
2) Start KV cache warmup job for 30m to seed prefix caches
3) Launch steady generator targeting 60% nominal tokens/sec for 4h
4) Inject micro-bursts: 30s bursts at 2.5x every 15min for first 2h, then 1h quiet, then 60s burst at 3x
5) Collect metrics: tokens/sec (per-second), p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rates, GPU util, batch sizes
6) Run regression detector against baseline (baseline run: 2026-02-20 04:00 UTC) and publish result
7) Archive raw traces to S3 and link in ticket
results: Initial run (2026-03-03): steady tokens/sec within 5% of target, p95 increased by 10% during first 20m (cache warmup), micro-bursts caused transient p95 spikes up to 2x for 20-40s
Follow-up run (2026-03-09): after increasing batching window from 12ms to 20ms, burst tail reduced by ~30%, sustained p95 steady-state improved by 8%
Regression detector fired on runtime change pr#7845 during canary (p95 +22%) — reverted kernel selector tuning; post-revert run returned to baseline
Known flake: a small fraction of requests (0.03%) observed 503s during autoscaler join; SRE ticket ENG-119900 created to harden join sequence
comments: 2026-02-27 - Sasha Mironov: Draft harness prototype completed. Generator supports Poisson and fixed-window bursts. Next: integrate with metrics exporter.
2026-03-03 - Priya Kapoor: Ran first 4h plateau. Observed expected warmup p95 bump; noting how KV cold-start dominates initial window. Recommendation: add 30m warmup phase to pipeline.
2026-03-06 - Mateo Chen (SRE): Reviewed autoscaler join logs; saw gap in ready-check that likely caused transient 503s. Action: SRE to add readiness gating and backoff during join.
2026-03-09 - Alina Gupta (Runtime): Kernel selector tweak in PR#7845 caused unexpected latency regression under burst traffic. Reverted and scheduled follow-up perf investigation.
2026-03-12 - Priya Kapoor: Added regression detector thresholds and CI job (ci/canary-autoscale). Scheduling weekly runs and gating Dedicated releases with 'no regression' flag.
notes: Statistical method: use non-parametric comparison (Mann-Whitney U) for p95 distributions plus EWMA on rolling windows to catch shifts quickly.
Prefer per-instance aggregation to avoid masking hot-instance regressions caused by shard imbalance.
Keep baseline artifact set immutable; record runtime, model weights, quantization profile, kernel variants.
